Removed 3 dead *_from_stdin fns (the *_from_port path handles StdIn, better UTF-8). tests/port_redirection.rs (8); full suite 669 + chibi green.

Shim now faithfully reproduces chibi's (chibi test) oracle (approx-equal? @ epsilon 1e-5, expect-first, complex part-wise, equal? for compounds) — verified against chibi-scheme's test.scm. Not a hand-relaxed oracle anymore; corpus 1225/1225 still pass. Conformance claim is now honest.

The user-facing need (throw typed errors, handle by type) is already met the idiomatic R7RS way: define-record-type + raise + guard dispatches by predicate, distinct record types are distinguishable, and the built-in error-object stays separate (verified + locked in by tests/exceptions.rs::user_records_serve_as_typed_conditions). The bead's Option A (a non-standard tag on the BUILT-IN error-object) is declined as redundant with records and speculative — the bead itself says to wait for the R7RS-large committee. A ratified condition system (SRFI 35-style) would be its own bead when it lands.
